notes.title: Beta Client - update [Linux]
notes.content:
We are back with the Beta Client to test the upcoming NW.js 0.13 version.
Build is using NW.js 0.13 beta 2.
If the build is running stable we will push the update to the stable version within this month. Hopefully this means a more stable Shadows of War with  fewer bugs, especially on Linux.The big changes are mostly under-the-hood and you probably wont notice them, but they are huge and will improve the game experience massively in the long run.

We will update this announcement with updates to the beta version. 
Next on we will begin to reinclude achievements and fix reported bugs.

1.15.1 -> 1.16
Updated:
Updated NW.js 0.12.3 to 0.13 Beta 2

Known Issues: Fullscreen is bugged.

We would especially like to request Linux users to try out this build and see if it fixes the issues they experience for them.

Please report bugs in the forums with [BETA] tag.

notes.title: The beta client update
notes.content:
This will probably be the only time we will report on an beta client update as an announcement, but we just wanted to share som important news. The beta client has made what it was supposed to do; Test out experimental fixes that actually worked as users reported the last game-breaking bug to be fixed. From here on out the route is pretty much straight forward again.
Sadly we have to do a compromise as this fix forces us to update NW.js which breaks Greenworks (Achievements/Overlay) support. We decided as we are pretty sure Greenworks will be fixed at some point, that in the next stable update this month (If the last beta client update goes smooth) we will update NW.js so the Overlay and Achievements will not be available normally. However we will upload a 1.9.2 version with Overlay and Achievement support as an extra branch for those that wants Achievements / Overlay. Wo do it like this because we feel like a working game is more worth than a partially working game with achievements, that's why we will roll this fix (Which only affects a portion of people as only some experienced that bug) out for all SoW players as a Stable update.

As a sneak preview we include the pre-patch notes for 1.9.2 here:

1.9.1 -> 1.9.2
Changed:
 Changed render from Back-to-Front render to Front-to-Back render.
 Buttons are now disabled when paused to prevent a Money bug abuse.
Fix:
 Bullet collision wasn't registered properly at fast-forward.
 Loading Screen stuck/crash is fixed.
Updated:
 Engine updated to v208.
 Updated Node-Webkit 0.10.5 to NW.js 0.12

For more information/if you want to take part on the discussion about the beta client please visit the SoW forums: http://steamcommunity.com/app/340220/discussions/0/530645446315512792/

Also as an extra note we want to announce a price change to SoW. 
Within a few days the price will change to 4.99€ ($4.99). If you have any feedback regarding that matter, feel free to comment ;)

notes.title: Beta Client (Loading Screen Fix)
notes.content:
As we push forward and want to keep delivering updates to continually fix the problems people are experiencing, we are launching a beta client.
We want to try to get more feedback based on that and want to be able to beta test our upcoming patches to decrease bugs in the Stable builds.
In the current beta we want to test NW.JS 0.12 - to see how it affects performance and some other known bugs, we had to disable achievements and Steam features for it to work. The beta is only available on Windows.

How to access the beta build?
1. Right click on "Shadows of War" in your Steam Library
2. Select "Properties"
3. Select the "Beta" tab
4. Select the "beta" in the dropdown and close the window.

We look forward to your feedback based on this initiative.

//Edit: As it looks like this Beta does what it meant to do - it fixes the Loading Screen freeze/crash bug.

notes.title: Update 1.9.1
notes.content:
This patch took a bit longer to complete due to its size of changes.
It features big changes that may not look like much in the beginning but change alot in the end. The whole Physics engine used has been switched out with another, and a new storage method for stats and campaign progress is used. Sadly this has the effect that previous saved stats and progress are not compatible. We also decided to make use of a new way of labelling patch number, the second value (in this case 9) represents the months since SoW launched. and the third value (in this case 1) represents the patch number of this month. This means that the next patch this month would be labelled 1.9.2 and next month would be 1.10.
Also a bug that made the game freeze in loading screen should be fixed, but since we couldn't reproduce it properly and we only suspect it to be fixed we didn't include it in the patch notes, please report whether it is fixed or not. Now for the part that you all waited for, the patch notes: 

1.9 -> 1.9.1
Changed:
 Box2D Physics engine changed to Chipmunk Physics.
 Refactored / Cleaned up code.
 Fast-Forward is now 4x faster instead of only 2x.
 Several Physics and other performance improvements. (20-42% better performance)
 Flashlight has been made slightly brighter.
 Removed VF Physics option.
 Changed Storage method used. (All previously saved stats are not compatible anymore)
Add:
 'Reset' Button added to Campaign which resets campaign progress.
 Render info now additionally shows which GPU is used.
 Prompt is now showing up on first start of the game if the player wants to play the tutorial.
Fix:
 Bunch of smaller fixes / improvements.
 Minimap pointer still shown while all units dead.
 Campaign match wouldn't finish / game stuck in loop.
Updated:
 Engine updated to v206.

If this patch fixes what it should, it will take a bit before the next patch comes out, that however should improve the "laggy" scrolling and some other things people may have problems with, as the next update will update NodeWebkit 0.11.6 to NW.js 0.12.0
It's going to be a major maintenance update.

notes.title: Customer service and upcoming stuff
notes.content:
Since we realised how horribly broken the launch was, 
we have invested our time and resources into fixing things and working things out.
Although we already released a short note on this matter, 
we've decided to go further and making what we think is the right approach.
Everyone that got Shadows of War on Steam, got a free extra Gift copy of it in their inventory. 
With this we want to apologize for the broken launch.
It is part of what we believe is the right initative in customer service.
We plan to keep updating the game and improving based on your feedback.
If you dont like it now, you may like it in the future.
This is kind of an Early Access approach, yes, however, 
last year when we released it on the other sites, we felt confident in it, we felt it was finished.
Now we realise there is still work that could have been done, and instead of letting our customers down and letting them having paid for a game they think is incomplete and/or broken,
we want to try to improve as best as possible.
To keep you updated on what is going to come in the next patch and what we are working on:
A Tutorial
A Minimap
Cloud Support
Improved Grammar
Gameplay improvements
 Further bug fixes and improvements
We really hope you appreciate our effort.
- Conti

notes.title: Game Breaking Bugs Fixed
notes.content:
With the latest patches, the horrible game breaking bugs have been fixed.
Finally after enough testing and pinning down the problems, 
the following bugs have been fixed that have made the game unplayable:
Instant Loose/Win in Skirmish/MP Battles.
Instant Win in the Campaign.

We are truly sorry for these game breaking bugs, the good thing is, they are fixed now and the game should be working as intended now. We can understand that people feel like this release have been an Early Acces release, however we are working as hard as possible on resolving the issues ASAP so people can enjoy the game as best as possible.
To round this up, we want to apologize for these bugs, now everything should be working.
If there still are bugs we want to let you know that we will work as hard as possible to fix them as fast as possible. I want to thank you for your patience and help with reporting these bugs.
